Kaitlin Powell is a data maestro!

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "A Beautiful Graphic",
    x = "Engine displacement",
    y = "Highway miles per gallon",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  )
```
